text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy, I spotted Calstone Light O agonizing over something with an intensely grim look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Grrrgh!! Nrrggghhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kgh... I must finish watching the instructional videos
regarding overseas expeditions by the end of today, butââ

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: This video is way, way too long!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There's no sign of finishing all of this.
Whatever should I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, the video was about five minutes long.
Thinking that it wasn't long at all, I—
choice_data_list: Well... how about watching it at 1.5x speed?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —! 1.5x speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. If it is too long, we simply make it faster.
A wonderfully straightforward and brilliant idea.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's try it right now.
Time for 1.5 times the speed――

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment, what are these buttons at the bottom?
5x speed? 10x speed?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The faster it is, the better, obviously.
Alright, let's crank it up to 10x speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her hand, there were indeed 5x and
10x buttons――
but those are probably for fast-forwarding!
choice_data_list: Wait, this is for fast-forwarding, so――

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOW, awesome, awesome, so fast, so fast!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fast fast fast faaaa—brrrrrbrrrrbrrrr
brrrrbrrrrbrrrrbrrrrbrrrrbrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even stop her, she began playback at 10x speed.
There's no way that's good for her eyes—!
choice_data_list: We have to stop the video...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reached out and slammed
the stop button on the video――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*Beep*)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ――Ha!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you stop for some reason?
You were going so fast, and it looked so great too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if it felt engaging, it isn't good for the body. I carefully explained this to her and persuaded her to at least watch at 1.5x speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Abababababababababababababababa
bababababababababababababababa!!
choice_data_list: (No good, she's not listening at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fast fast fast amazing amazing aaah!!
Trainer, look, look, brrrrbbrrrbb!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a thrilled look, she turned her tablet
toward me――!
An absurdly fast video caught my eye――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fast, fast, too faaaast...!
It's way too fast for my eyes to track, brrrrbbrrrbb—

text_block_list.name: Passing Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, you two!?
Are you okay!? Hey, pull yourselves together...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, a teacher intervened and spared us from further trouble...
but for a while, those dizzying images remained burned into my mind.
